2026_04_DEN_SF.headline: Denver’s resilient defense gets the league’s hottest early-season scoring test in Santa Clara
2026_04_DEN_SF.paragraph1: Denver has steadied defensively after a difficult opener, responding with stronger second-half work against Jacksonville and the Rams. San Francisco reaches Week 4 unbeaten and atop the latest league power rankings after scoring 98 points through three games despite offensive injuries. That makes Denver’s ability to limit explosives and win obvious passing downs the central test, while the 49ers must keep their protection and spacing intact against a Broncos front that has already shown it can adjust within games.
2026_04_DEN_SF.model_rationale: Denver’s best path is to compress explosive plays and create long-yardage situations; San Francisco’s offensive consistency makes protection, tackling and second-half adjustments especially important.
